findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ means pickling the Sentinel members falls back to Enum's default reduction, which serializes by value. Because the member values are plain object() instances, unpickling cannot find the original member.
findings.rationale: Trigger: pickle.dumps(UNSET) followed by pickle.loads on the result, which can happen when a Click context or parameter holding UNSET is sent to a multiprocessing worker. Mechanism: the old __reduce_ex__ returned getattr(Sentinel, name), so the loaded value was the singleton. With it removed, the default reduce re-creates Sentinel(<new object()>), which does not match any member, so Enum raises ValueError or yields a different object. Impact: unpickling fails or returns a non-identical sentinel, so 'is UNSET' checks break after a round trip.
